what_happened: On a design job, the user corrected Athena's accepted reading 1. The reading rested on a record of earlier work, but it did not include the facts the user wanted in it. The producer cannot see records/, so the user supplied the figures: the test-suite speedup took three rejected attempts (about 9 dollars and 4 hours). Each attempt made a real gain, taking the test check from about 12 to 7.4-7.8 minutes. They were rejected for missing a fixed time target that no measurement had shown was reachable. A narrowed request then landed it. Cut A took four tries (a timing race, a wait stopping on the wrong check, duplicate push-triggered runs). The user also asked for one thrash signal: a line of work rejected twice for the same unmet criterion.
cause: The reading names a record as the grounding for the work, but nothing checks whether the producer can read that record. The producer works from a one-commit copy without records/. A reading that says to ground the work in job history therefore has no figures to use, and the gap shows up only when the user reads the reading. The reading step does not carry the needed facts (job ids, costs, durations, rejection reasons) into the reading text itself.
prevention: Add a check at reading acceptance. When a reading cites job records, history or the records branch as a source, it must either quote the needed figures inline or list them in a reachable file. The check compares each cited source against the producer's reachable paths and flags any source that is not reachable. The reading step would run it and pull the figures from records itself before the reading is accepted.
proposed_request: Add a check to the reading stage. If an accepted reading cites job records, the records branch or any path the producer's one-commit working copy cannot see, the reading must include the needed facts inline (job ids, costs, durations, rejection reasons, unmet criteria) taken from the records. If it does not, the reading is returned for revision with the unreachable source named. Acceptance: (1) a test with a reading that cites records/ and has no inline figures is refused; (2) a test with the same reading with the figures inline is accepted; (3) a reading that cites only paths in the working copy is unaffected; (4) CHANGELOG.md is the only file outside the reading-stage code and its tests that may change.
